Task: Fix PowerShell CLIXML decoding in the checked-out repository.

- `_parse_clixml` now has typed byte input/output and a typed stream argument.

- Valid UTF-16 escape units, surrogate pairs, and control characters are decoded. Invalid escapes and standalone uppercase `_x005F_` are preserved; standalone lowercase `_x005f_` decodes to `_`; output uses UTF-8 `surrogatepass` for unmatched surrogates.
- Unit tests cover these behaviors and preserve encoded trailing CRLF.

diff --git a/test/units/plugins/shell/test_powershell.py b/test/units/plugins/shell/test_powershell.py
index 90ee008..a6e0d65 100644
--- a/test/units/plugins/shell/test_powershell.py
+++ b/test/units/plugins/shell/test_powershell.py
@@ -3,6 +3,29 @@ from __future__ import annotations
 from ansible.plugins.shell.powershell import _parse_clixml, ShellModule
 
 
+def test_parse_clixml_decodes_utf16_escapes_and_preserves_invalid_tokens():
+    data = (b'<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">A_x263A__xD83D__xDE00__x000D__x000A_'
+            b'_x005f__x000A_ _x005F_ _x005G_ _xD800_</S></Objs>')
+    expected = 'A☺😀\r\n_\n _x005F_ _x005G_ \ud800'.encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == expected
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_filters_stream_and_joins_only_between_nonempty_blocks():
+    data = (b'<Objs Version="1"><S S="Info">ignored</S><S S="Error">one</S>'
+            b'<S S="Error">two</S></Objs><Objs Version="1"><S S="Info">other</S></Objs>'
+            b'<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error" /><S S="Error">three</S></Objs>')
+    assert _parse_clixml(data) == b'onetwo\r\nthree'
+    assert _parse_clixml(data, stream='Info') == b'ignored\r\nother'
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_empty_matching_elements_return_empty_bytes():
+    assert _parse_clixml(b'<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error" /></Objs><Objs Version="1"><S S="Info">x</S></Objs>') == b''
+
+
+def test_parse_clixml_decodes_standalone_lowercase_underscore_escape():
+    assert _parse_clixml(b'<Objs Version="1"><S S="Error">_x005f_</S></Objs>') == b'_'
+
+
